claims.evidence: The witness photos show stacked used tyres, but no readable brand/origin/DOT/labels are visible to confirm Belgium distribution.

risks.risk: Tyre sizes (width/aspect/rim) are unknown, so compatibility and resale value are uncertain.
risks.proof: A clear close-up of the full sidewall text on multiple tyres showing size (e.g., 205/55R16) and rim size, plus a count of how many tyres per size.
risks.if_unproven: Price as assorted used tyres with unknown sizes (worst-case for buyer fit), not as a specific size lot.

risks.risk: Quantity by size/pattern is unknown; uneven mixes reduce value.
risks.proof: A shot showing the full stack layout with a tally (or a video pan) and close-ups confirming each size/pattern.
risks.if_unproven: Price as mixed quantity with no guarantee of matching sets.

risks.risk: Tread depth and remaining life are not measurable from these images; some tyres may be near end-of-life.
risks.proof: A close-up with a tread-depth gauge reading (mm) on several tyres, plus a photo of the wear bars if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used tyres with potentially low tread life.

risks.risk: Damage status (punctures, sidewall cuts, bulges, repairs) is not confirmed; only general wear is visible.
risks.proof: Close-ups of sidewalls and tread for each tyre showing no bulges/cuts/repairs, ideally with a flashlight inspection clip.
risks.if_unproven: Price as tyres with unknown damage risk (worst-case: may include defective tyres).

risks.risk: Tubeless vs tube-type is unknown; this affects usability and cost.
risks.proof: A clear sidewall marking indicating TL (tubeless) or TT (tube-type) on multiple tyres.
risks.if_unproven: Price as tubeless-unknown/assorted, assuming buyer may need extra checks.

risks.risk: Manufacturing year/DOT date and age history are unknown; older tyres can be unsafe even if tread remains.
risks.proof: Clear DOT date close-ups (week/year) on multiple tyres.
risks.if_unproven: Price as older used tyres with unknown age.

risks.risk: Matching sets for a vehicle are not guaranteed; mismatched brands/sizes/patterns reduce value.
risks.proof: Photos showing all tyres in the lot grouped by identical size/brand/pattern, with sidewall brand/model readable.

proof_requests: Provide clear sidewall close-ups showing exact size (e.g., 205/55R16) for each tyre type in the lot.
Provide DOT date (week/year) close-ups for several tyres across the lot.
Provide tread-depth measurements in mm (gauge reading) on multiple tyres, plus photos of wear bars if present.
Provide close-ups of sidewalls and tread to check for punctures, cuts, bulges, and any repairs.
Confirm tubeless vs tube-type markings (TL/TT) with readable sidewall text.
Show how many tyres of each size/pattern are included (tally or video pan).
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type as used car tyres (assorted sizes). However, key value drivers (size, tread depth, damage, DOT age, matching sets) are not verifiable from the provided images, so the item should be priced at the worst-case assumptions for mixed used tyres until the requested proof is provided.
